subject: Forest Temple
text: The main goal in the Forest Temple is to defeat the four Poe Sisters and recover their stolen flames to reactivate the central elevator.

evidence.quote: Near the beginning of the dungeon, four Poe Sisters steal flames from a large altar, which causes an elevator in the middle of the altar to retract.  The main goal in the dungeon is tracking down and killing the Poe Sisters, and reclaiming their flames to reactivate the elevator.

subject: Gray Wolfos
text: Gray Wolfos can be defeated by backflipping out of their attack range and immediately performing a Jump Attack while their back is turned.

evidence.quote: Defeat them the same way you defeated the Gray Wolfos you encountered as a child: wait for them to attack, then backflip out of range, and immediately execute a Jump Attack while their back is turned.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located at the top-right of the ivy wall near the trees at the Forest Temple entrance.

evidence.quote: Once you are at the top of the tree, look to the top-right of the ivy wall to find a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Forest Temple Entrance
text: A Small Key is inside a chest at the end of the adjacent tree branch above the entrance courtyard.

evidence.quote: Edge along to the edge of the tree branch, then jump to the tree branch adjacent to it.  Edge along this tree branch to the end, and open the chest to find a Small Key.

subject: Big Skulltula
text: A single shot from the Hookshot instantly kills a Big Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Now, a single shot from the Hookshot to any part of the Big Skulltula will kill it instantly.

subject: The Torch Room
text: In the Torch Room, the four Poe Sisters appear and steal the four torch flames, lowering the central elevator.

evidence.quote: Run forward into the rooms a short ways, and the four Poe Sisters will appear and steal the four flames from the torches in the center of the room.  This will cause the elevator in the center of the room to lower.

subject: The Torch Room
text: A Gold Skulltula is located to the right at the top of the stairs in the Torch Room.

evidence.quote: At the top of the stairs, look to the right to spot a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Hookshot, then go through the door at the top of the stairs.

subject: Stalfos
text: Stalfos will not attack if one is Z-Targeted, and they become vulnerable to attacks from behind or the side immediately following their attacks, especially jump attacks.

evidence.quote: The Stalfos are slightly chivalrous, and will not attack you if you have one of them Z-Targeted.  So Z-Target one of them as quick as you can... Stalfos can block most of your attacks, but just like Wolfos they are briefly vulnerable immediately after they attack.  This is especially true after they perform their Jump Attack.  Attack them from the side or from behind immediately after they attack to dispatch them easily.

subject: Lower Stalfos Chamber
text: Defeating both Stalfos in the Lower Stalfos Chamber causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear.

evidence.quote: Once both of the Stalfos are dead, a chest will appear in the center of the room.  Open it to get a Small Key.

subject: Blue Block
text: Playing the Song of Time with the Ocarina of Time removes the blue block in the Torch Room hallway, uncovering a door.

evidence.quote: Stand near the block and play the Song of Time with the Ocarina of Time to remove the block, revealing a door.

subject: West Courtyard
text: Climbing the ivy wall on the right side of the West Courtyard leads to an alcove with a door.

evidence.quote: Go to the right side of the courtyard, where you will find an ivy wall... Climb the Ivy Wall, sticking as far to the right as possible to avoid the Skullwalltula.  Enter the alcove at the top of the ivy wall and go through the door inside.

subject: Balcony Hallway
text: Defeating the Blue Bubble in the Balcony Hallway unlocks the exit door and spawns a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Kill the Blue Bubble, and the door on the other end of the hall will open, and a chest will appear.  Open the chest to get the Dungeon Map.

subject: East Courtyard Balcony
text: Hookshotting to the target above the opposite balcony and pressing the floor switch drains the well in the corner of the East Courtyard.

evidence.quote: Look to the left to see another balcony with a small white circle above it.  Shoot this circle with the Hookshot to pull yourself over to that balcony.  Step on the switch on this balcony, and the well in the corner of the Courtyard will drain.

subject: East Courtyard
text: A Gold Skulltula is clinging to the wall around the corner from the chest on the cliff in the East Courtyard.

evidence.quote: If you stand on the right side of the dirt path where it dead-ends at the pool, you can use your Hookshot to latch onto the chest... The real prize is the Gold Skulltula, which is found clinging to the wall around the corner from the chest.

subject: The Well
text: A chest at the end of the well passage contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Open the chest at the end of the passage to find a Small Key.

subject: The Well
text: Climbing the ivy wall at the end of the well passage leads back to the West Courtyard.

evidence.quote: Climb up the Ivy Wall to it's top to find yourself back in the West Courtyard.

subject: The Torch Room
text: The locked door at the top of the stairs in the Torch Room requires a Small Key and leads toward the West Passage.

evidence.quote: Go up the stairs and use one of your Small Keys to open the door.

subject: Blue Bubble
text: A Blue Bubble can be made vulnerable by letting it touch your raised shield while Z-Targeting it, or stunned using the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Defeat it by holding up your Shield while Z- Targeting it, and let it touch you.  This will cause the blue flame around it to vanish, at which point it will become vulnerable.  Alternatively, you can also stun it with the Hookshot, but the Blue Bubble's speed and the Hookshot's slowness can make this strategy problematic.
